sections.title: How to Open the Hood of an Aventro Vehicle

location.heading: How to Open the Hood of an Aventro Vehicle

blocks.text: Opening the hood of your Aventro car is a simple process that gives you access to the engine compartment for checks and maintenance. Follow these steps:

location.heading: How to Open the Hood of an Aventro Vehicle

items.text: Park the Car Safely
Ensure your car is parked on a level surface.
Turn off the engine and engage the parking brake.
Locate the Hood Release Lever
The hood release lever is usually located under the dashboard, to the right or left of the driver’s seat (near the footwell).
Look for a lever with a hood icon (it may show a car with an open hood).
Pull the Hood Release Lever
Pull the lever firmly. You should hear a slight click as the hood pops up a little.
Move to the Front of the Car
Go to the front of the vehicle.
The hood will now be slightly raised.
Find the Secondary Latch
Slide your hand under the center front edge of the hood.
Feel for the secondary latch (usually a small lever or tab).
Push or slide the latch to one side to release the hood completely.
Lift the Hood
Lift the hood open.
(Some models may have hydraulic struts; if not, locate the prop rod and secure the hood in the open position.)
Secure the Hood
If your model uses a prop rod:
Find the prop rod and insert it into the designated slot on the underside of the hood.
For hoods with hydraulic struts, the hood will stay open automatically.

location.heading: How to Open the Hood of an Aventro Vehicle

items.text: Remove the Prop Rod (if applicable) and place it back into its holder.
Lower the Hood Gently to about 30 cm (1 foot) above the latch, then allow it to drop shut.
Check it is Securely Latched by pressing gently on the front edge—do not slam.

location.heading: How to Open the Hood of an Aventro Vehicle

items.text: Never open the hood while the car is moving.
Allow engine components to cool before touching.
Always ensure the hood is closed securely before driving.

blocks.text: For any difficulties or if the hood does not open as expected, refer to your Aventro Owner’s Manual or visit your nearest Aventro Service Center.
